citation: Gibson, McGuire; Judith A. Franke; Miguel Civil; Michael L. Bates; Joachim Boessneck; Karl W. Butzer; Ted A. Rathbun; and Elizabeth Frick Mallin. 1978. Excavations at Nippur: Twelfth Season. Oriental Institute Communications 23. Chicago: The Oriental Institute of the University of Chicago. ISBN 0-918986-22-2. xiv + 190 pp., 92 figures, 16 tables.
